pages.text: $(bold)Infinity$(): infinity, woven between all things. $(br2)Press the technique release key (C) to $(bold)activate$(), and press it again to $(bold)deactivate$() — a toggling sustained technique: it $(bold)stays active when you switch techniques$(), and once you switch back you can press C to switch it off as usual. $(br2)While active: $(li)incoming damage $(bold)below the threshold$() → completely nullified$(li)$(bold)above the threshold$() → each point of overflow damage is offset by Cursed Energy$(br2)$(bold)Threshold$() = (1 + (Cursed Energy Affinity/10 + Cursed Energy Output)/10) × 10

$(li)each point of overflow damage costs (1 - Cursed Energy Output/10) × 10 Cursed Energy$(li)Cursed Energy runs dry → $(bold)auto-deactivates$(), and you suffer $(bold)shield-break damage$() = overflow damage × 5 (unblockable)$(br2)An extremely high ceiling of protection, yet a single strike stronger than the threshold will quickly burn through your Cursed Energy and trigger the shield-break backlash — use with care. Occupies a technique slot.
